scoring_justification: T0: Ed values cannot be recomputed from raw AIMD trajectories in the checker sandbox; compare reported values to paper's published Ed with tolerance ±5 eV.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold Ed values for the four PKA/condition combinations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Table 2 (unfaulted C[001]=19 eV, unfaulted Si[001]=95 eV) and Table 3 (ISF_AC C1[001]=64 eV, ISF_AC Si1[001]=69 eV)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: matches the official paper results and the reference solve.sh uses them

outputs.description: The file must contain four rows. The checker will compare each reported Ed value to the corresponding hidden reference value from the original study, using a tolerance appropriate for AIMD reproducibility. The score is the proportion of values that match within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The scored artifact is a CSV compilation of the threshold displacement energies obtained from the AIMD simulations. The checker does not access any external datasets; all reference values are embedded in the hidden grading specification.
